description: Ministry of Plantations - The Sri Lanka Tea Board (Analysis and Quality Certification of Tea) Regulations 2021
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Sri Lanka Tea Board under the Sri Lanka Tea Board Law No. 14 of 1975, establishing an Analytical Laboratory and setting standards for tea analysis and quality certification.
